description: A bacterial infection of the deeper dermis and subcutaneous tissue causing a localized painful inflammatory skin reaction.
symptoms: Fever or other systemic symptoms may occur

appearance.general: An area of painful swollen inflamed skin, often on a limb; the affected area may enlarge progressively.

warning_signs: Rapidly spreading redness, severe pain, fever, systemic illness, or involvement of the face or eye region requires prompt medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss recent wounds, athlete's foot, swelling, diabetes, and prior episodes.
